name: Yesha Prajapati
sub: Campaigns, brand systems and the CRM plumbing underneath them, at Archer Lewis. Before this I worked on organic search for Ford.com.
statement: Most of my job is making sure 35 firms can market themselves without running

bio.text: Each firm has its own market and its own clients, but they share a brand. So most of the work is building something once and making it hold up everywhere it lands.
At VML I worked on organic search for Ford.com. Mostly keyword and competitor research, written up as recommendations the content teams could use.
Before that: four internships across social, product marketing and creative. Small teams, so I got to do a bit of everything.

seoDesc: Marketing operations at Archer Lewis. Campaigns, brand systems and CRM for 35 accounting firms. Previously organic search for Ford.com at VML.
